response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), profile_avgs AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM filtered GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS mean_avg FROM profile_avgs) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_band, p.telescope_count, p.avg_band - o.mean_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM profile_avgs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL;
